newsitem.title: USA: AES, partner to buy Argentine power firms.
newsitem.headline: AES, partner to buy Argentine power firms.

text.p: AES Corp said Tuesday it and partner CEA won a bid to acquire two integrated electricity companies serving Buenos Aires, Argentina for $565 million.

The sale of the companies, Empresa Distribudora Electrica Norte (Eden), serving the northern part of the province, and Empresa Distribudora Electrica Sur (Edes), serving the southern part, are part of the Argentine government's privatization plan.
Known as CEA, Community Energy Alternatives is a New Jersey-based independent power producer owned by Public Service Enterprise Group.

AES said it and CEA will acquire a 90 percent ownership in each company from the Buenos Aires provincial government. AES will own 60 percent, CEA will own 30 percent and 10 percent will be owned by the employees of companies.
AES said the transaction is subject to regulatory approvals, and is expected to be completed shortly.
